name: Custom Server (own command)
description: Bring your own binary: point Between at any server executable or script. Optionally download and extract an archive first. Full console, backups, schedules and monitoring included.

variables.label: Start command
variables.description: Executed in the server directory, e.g. ./start.sh or java -jar server.jar

variables.label: Install download URL (optional)
variables.description: Archive (.zip/.tar.gz) or single file to download during install. Leave empty to skip.

variables.label: Download target name
variables.description: File name to save the download as (archives are extracted automatically).

notes: If your server has a graceful console stop command, override the stop behavior in the server settings.
